scenarios.title: With a Quirky desktop window open under a fresh temporary QUIRKY_HOME, quirky open reports readiness without creating another native window or invoking the OS opener again

With no desktop window under an isolated profile, quirky open succeeds only after the packaged macOS Quirky window becomes available; launcher success with no attached desktop is not reported as ready
Clicking a live Activity thread selects its exact workspace and terminal session and physical keyboard input reaches that pane without focusing another session
